description: This file contains interface definitions, state classes, and observer interfaces related to streaming grains in an Orleans-based distributed system, primarily used for testing streaming functionalities.

classes.name: Streaming_ProducerGrain_State
classes.description: State class holding a list of producer observers for a streaming grain.

classes.name: Streaming_ConsumerGrain_State
classes.description: State class holding a list of consumer observers for a streaming grain.

classes.name: Streaming_ProducerConsumerGrain_State
classes.description: State class holding lists of both producer and consumer observers for a streaming grain.

methods.name: BecomeProducer
methods.description: Method to set the grain as a producer for a specific stream.

methods.name: RenewProducer
methods.description: Method to renew or refresh producer state or connection.

methods.name: StopBeingProducer
methods.description: Method to deactivate the grain as a producer.

methods.name: ProduceSequentialSeries
methods.description: Method to produce a series of items sequentially.

methods.name: ProduceParallelSeries
methods.description: Method to produce items in parallel series.

methods.name: ProducePeriodicSeries
methods.description: Method to produce items periodically using a timer function.

methods.name: ExpectedItemsProduced
methods.description: Property to get the expected number of items produced.

methods.name: ItemsProduced
methods.description: Property to get the number of items actually produced.

methods.name: AddNewConsumerGrain
methods.description: Method to add a new consumer grain to the producer's list.

methods.name: ProducerCount
methods.description: Property to get the current count of producers.

methods.name: VerifyFinished
methods.description: Method to verify that production has finished.

methods.name: BecomeConsumer
methods.description: Method to set the grain as a consumer for a specific stream.

methods.name: RenewConsumer
methods.description: Method to renew or refresh consumer state or connection.

methods.name: StopBeingConsumer
methods.description: Method to deactivate the grain as a consumer.

methods.name: ItemsConsumed
methods.description: Property to get the number of items consumed.

methods.name: ConsumerCount
methods.description: Property to get the current count of consumers.
